actuatorAuth.title: Actuator authentication (the token is the actuator-token secret)

autoRefresh.title: Allow bounded minute polling after explicit scoped Start (instance only)

snapshotInlays.title: Show cached exact-key snapshot observations in configuration and @Value annotations

refreshBudgetMs.title: Maximum cooperative refresh batch budget in ms (1,000–60,000)

pollAttempts.title: Maximum request batches per explicitly started polling lease (1–10; lease expires after 10 min)
